subject.title: Session hangs indefinitely when compaction times out, causing repeated duplicate message sends

question: What should be the canonical recovery and idempotency boundary when compaction times out after a reply may already have been delivered?
rationale: The source gaps are real, but the durable fix changes session-state, channel-delivery, and operator-recovery semantics across several active related trackers and cannot be chosen safely as a narrow autonomous patch.

options.title: Choose a unified recovery contract
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical combined tracker while maintainers land or reject the narrower compaction and delivery PRs, then require one end-to-end contract for terminal state, send idempotency, and in-product recovery.

options.title: Split after linked trackers own all parts
options.body: Maintain separate canonical issues for compaction progress, lane starvation, and duplicate delivery, and close this only after each remaining behavior is explicitly linked and covered.

options.title: Limit core to existing mitigations
options.body: Accept the current partial mitigations and treat broader duplicate-send/idempotency recovery as plugin or operator guidance, leaving some reported failure modes outside core guarantees.

recommendation.title: Choose a unified recovery contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the canonical combined tracker while maintainers land or reject the narrower compaction and delivery PRs, then require one end-to-end contract for terminal state, send idempotency, and in-product recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the current live assignee and the clearest available owner for deciding whether this remains the combined canonical tracker or is split into narrower maintainer-owned fixes.
